result.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code § 13.76.130(A)(8)(g) (Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance, Ord. No. 7,950-N.S.); see also id. § 13.76.130(A)(8)(h)
result.citation_basis: § 13.76.130(A)(8)(g) and (A)(8)(h): O096 (also O050); ch. 13.76 short title 'Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance': O050 (§ 13.76.010); Ord. No. 7,950-N.S.: O050, and O096 history note (Ord. 7950-NS § 2, 2024)
result.official_quote: Where a landlord recovers possession of a unit under Subsection 13.76.130(A)(8), the landlord is required to provide standard relocation assistance to tenant households where at least one occupant has resided in the unit for one year or more in the amount of $15,000. The landlord is required to provide an additional $5,000 relocation assistance to tenant households that qualify as low-income; or include disabled or elderly tenants; minor children; or tenancies which began prior to January 1, 1999.
result.condition: You get the standard owner move-in relocation payment only if at least one person in your household has lived in the unit for one year or more, and the additional payment only if your household is low-income, includes a disabled or elderly (60+) tenant or a minor child, or your tenancy began before January 1, 1999.
result.condition_quote: the landlord is required to provide standard relocation assistance to tenant households where at least one occupant has resided in the unit for one year or more in the amount of $15,000
result.note: The lawyer's § 13.76.130(A) was narrowed to (A)(8)(g), where the codified text in O096 places the owner move-in relocation rule, with the CPI indexing in (A)(8)(h) added as see also; the parenthetical uses the chapter's own short title and Ord. No. 7,950-N.S. from O050 and O096's history note, the 2026 dollar amounts come from the Rent Board's indexing (O051, D004) rather than the code text, and the card's quoted span stays from D004, an agency news page in the supplied corpus that is not the law's text.
